summary: Computes the normalized face normal of a triangle from three float vertex pointers (a1, a2, a3) via cross product of the two edge vectors (a3-a2) and (a1-a2), writes the normalized result into the 3-float output pointer a4. Returns 0 on success and -1 on a degenerate (zero-area) triangle where the squared cross-product length is <= 0.0.

local_names.a2: vertex B (float xyz, shared reference point)

operations.description: Compute edge vectors U = a1 - a2 and V = a3 - a2 componentwise; each vertex is read as three floats (components accessed through vertex fields this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8).
Compute cross product N = U x V (components v5, v16, v6).
Compute squared length of the cross product: v6*v6 + v16*v16 + v5*v5.
If squared cross-product length <= 0.0 (degenerate/zero-area triangle, threshold from global zero sentinel dbl_59E430), take the failure path.
On degenerate triangle: set return value to -1 and normalization scale to 1.0 (from global dbl_59E420).
On valid triangle: normalization scale = 1.0 / sqrt(squared length) (1.0 from global dbl_59E420).
Write scaled normal components v8*v5, v16*v8, v8*v6 into output pointer a4 (a4[0], a4[1], a4[2]).
Return 0 on success, -1 on degenerate triangle.

clean_pseudocode: edge1 = a1 - a2; edge2 = a3 - a2;
unresolved: The packet stores vertex components as this+0x0/0x4/0x8 fields while the raw source reads them through three separate float pointers a1/a2/a3; the exact object the fields belong to is unknown.
